newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-CBA says plans no new debt programmes.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-CBA says plans no new debt programmes.

text.p: Commonwealth Bank of Australia said on Thursday it was not planning to launch any new offshore or domestic debt programmes for the rest of calendar 1996.

"At this stage, nothing other than the normal funding of our balance sheet in Australia (is planned). The sort of programmes you've seen over the last 12 months will more or less continue," managing director David Murray told reporters.
CBA's issuance from existing programmes also would remain at similar levels to those of recent times, Murray said.

CBA's long term and short term debt is rated AA minus and A1 plus by Standard & Poor's Corp while Moody's Investor Service rates the bank's senior unguaranteed long term obligations at Aa3 and short term obligations at Prime-1.
At 0507 GMT (3.07 p.m.) CBA shares were up 12 cents to A$11.22.
